name: Cult Ambush
text: When this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 (+3 if BATTLELINE). On a 4+ it joins your Cult Ambush pool and you place a marker over 9 inches from all enemies. After your opponent's Reinforcements step, each marker returns one pooled unit at full strength via Deep Strike, touching it. Enemy models ending a move within 9 inches remove it. No returns in rounds 4-5.

name: Spiritual Leader
text: While this model leads a unit, every model in that unit has a 5+ Feel No Pain save against wounds caused by Psychic attacks.

name: Vile Insurrectionists
text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you may re-roll a hit roll of 1.

name: Vile Insurrectionists (objective)
text: If the target of the attack is within range of an objective marker, you may also re-roll a wound roll of 1.

name: Cult Ambush
text: When this unit is destroyed, roll a D6, adding 1 in rounds 1 and 2. On a 5+ it joins your Cult Ambush pool and you place a marker over 9 inches from all enemies. From round 2, after your opponent's Reinforcements step, it returns as a fresh copy wholly within 3 inches of the marker, over 9 inches from enemies. While pooled it counts as in Reserves, so units still waiting after round 3 are lost.

name: Master Outrider
text: After this unit has shot in your Shooting phase, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy, it may make a Normal move of up to 6 inches. If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Crossfire
text: After this unit has shot in your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit it hit. Until the end of the turn, attacks by your GENESTEALER CULTS units against that unit improve their Armour Penetration by 1. Each enemy unit can be picked once per turn.
